checks.result: No concrete defect found by source review
checks.evidence: App/ProjectDocumentIO.swift:73-109. Non-file URLs are rejected before scope access. defer is installed immediately after startAccessingSecurityScopedResource and calls stop only when start returned true; it covers preflight errors, coordination, accessor reads, decoding and thrown outcomes. A false start does not incorrectly reject an otherwise accessible sandbox URL.

checks.evidence: App/ProjectDocumentIO.swift:92-109. The accessor reads the coordinator-supplied URL; coordinationError is thrown before a captured result is returned, and a missing accessor result produces unreadable. NativeTests/ProjectDocumentIOTests.swift:137-201 registers HoldingPresenter and checks propagation of the original NSError domain/code plus unchanged bytes.

checks.evidence: App/ProjectDocumentIO.swift:65-123 contains no source writes or library mutation. NativeTests/ProjectDocumentIOTests.swift:14-34 checks exact source bytes, unchanged directory contents and continued use of the returned project after removal of its source file; lines 36-49, 81-117 and 119-133 assert rejection/byte preservation for oversized, nonregular, malformed and non-file inputs. These tests were inspected, not executed.

checks.evidence: App/ProjectDocumentIO.swift:98-130 captures accessor throws with Result, returns through result.get(), preserves document decode errors, and maps bounded-reader tooLarge/notRegularFile/unreadable into their declared document/import errors.

checks.evidence: App/ProjectDocumentIO.swift:6-31 encodes the project into immutable Data before export; initialization and file-wrapper creation throw on errors. Reading a supplied FileWrapper requires regular-file contents and successful document decoding before retaining original bytes. The prepared document has no project-library mutation.

Repository status, current branch/HEAD and open work were not independently inventoried; all file reads used the coordinator-provided pinned commit.
conclusion: No concrete must-fix finding in the assigned source/test scope. Native/provider execution remains unverified; this is not milestone acceptance.
